meta.purpose: Remediate every confirmed legacy, dead, and incorrect element found by the fresh-eyes audit so masterplan’s documented surface matches its code.
meta.problem: Behavioral defects, live-state drift, dead material, stale configuration, misleading documentation, and release drift leave CI red and permit silent failures.
meta.solution: Apply bounded repairs and removals across five ordered content waves, add regressions for each behavioral defect, then complete and verify the tagged release flow end to end.
